concepts.def: Hottest type, surface above 30,000 K, blue-white.
Coolest type, surface below 3,700 K, red.
Dark feature where cool gas absorbs specific wavelengths.
Peak wavelength times temperature is a constant.
'Oh Be A Fine Girl/Guy Kiss Me' for OBAFGKM.

walkthroughs.body_html: From hottest to coolest: O B A F G K M. O stars exceed 30,000 K and shine blue; M stars are below 3,700 K and shine red. The Sun is type G2.
Each spectral type has characteristic absorption lines. Hot O stars show ionised helium; cool M stars show molecular bands. The pattern reveals temperature, composition and motion.
lambda_peak * T = 2.9 x 10^-3 m K. A 6,000 K star peaks near 500 nm (yellow-green); cooler stars peak in red and infrared.
